# Invoice Reconciliation Demo — Blueprint

## 1. Use Case Summary
This demo illustrates an agentic invoice reconciliation assistant for a mid-size FMCG distributor.

## 2. Assumptions
- Documents are pre-converted to structured JSON.
- Currency is USD.

## 3. Agent and Tool Architecture
| Agent | Role | Inputs | Outputs |
|-------|------|--------|---------|
| intake_agent | Parse documents | uploaded files | parsed JSON |
| matching_agent | Compare line items | parsed JSON | match results |
| exception_agent | Flag mismatches | match results | exceptions |
| summary_agent | Draft email | match results + exceptions | summary email |

## 4. Synthetic Data Spec
- 20 invoices with 5 line items each.
- 18 POs matching 18 invoices; 2 invoices have no PO.
- 8 intentional mismatches above 2%.

## 5. Mock GUI Spec
Streamlit app with: file upload panel, batch processing button, exception review table, approve/reject buttons, report download.

## 6. Mocked LLM Layer
mock_llm_instructions.json keyed by agent_name.step_id with 2 variants each.

## 7. Audit Logging Spec
logs/audit.jsonl fields: ts, run_id, agent, event_type, step_id, input, output, latency_ms, mock_source_key.

## 8. Folder Structure
demo/
  data/
  agents/
  tools/
  audit/
  gui/
  logs/
  tests/
  mock_llm_instructions.json
  requirements.txt

## 9. Acceptance Checklist
1. pytest passes with no failures.
2. All manifest files exist.
3. No anthropic/openai imports.
4. audit.jsonl is written.
5. GUI launches without error.
